description.text: This four- year program is designed to provide English language instruction combined with a broad range of courses relating business management .The firt two academic yeas will focus on language training and basic business courses .The third year will be a transitional period from intensive language trainig to interdisciplinary instruction of some more practical courses .The fourth year will see a mix of further language traning and specific career-oriented courses as that of Introduction to Economics ,Marketing ,International Trade Practice and Operation ,International Business Law ,International Finance ,Logistics and Port Ecnomy ,WTO and China's Trade etc.Four weeks of work practicum ensure graduates enter the competitive job market with practical experience in business management .Bachelor degree will be conferred to those students have fulfilled the stipulated curriculum ,acquired 120 credits ,and past HSK Band 4. Applicants with IELTS score above 5.0 are eligible.

duration.text: The English at Zhejiang Wanli University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1388 USD/per semester ￥ 10000 CNY/per semester

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3or above 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Graduation certificate of high school Gradution certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not,it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.

requirements.text: Applicant is under the age of 25, and is in good health, high-school graduate with good marks. The HSK score should reach level 3 or above
